fields.statement: At b364a6a7b (attempt 2), ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/guide/... ./internal/workflow/... -run Unchained: TestPlanReviewDoneUnchained (plan-review topic says session done runs as its own command only after rhiza run findings / run verdict / the reviser's apply succeeded, never chained with ';', and stays within TopicCap) and TestPlanReviewPromptsUnchained (plan and plan-milestone review, critic and revise prompts carry 'as a separate command', the recording command, 'succeeded' and 'never chained after it with `;`') both PASS. Read the diffs of 5a50d91ce and b364a6a7b: guide text and both builtin TOMLs carry the instruction. Attempt 1's finding is fixed: plan-workflow, plan-workflow-pr and plan-milestone-backlog now assert the new reviewer, critic and reviser prompts (and the critic->fresh->check steps), and with GOTMPDIR overridden to a scratch dir, go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(plan-workflow|plan-workflow-pr|plan-milestone-backlog|plan-workflow-ci-infra-wait|describe-golden)$' all PASS.
